channel.title: Wire — Databases
channel.description: Databases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: From the Trenches: My Path Through Postgres
item.description: From Oracle defender to Postgres zealot: one engineer's 20-year journey through VACUUM bugs, 35k TPS trading systems, HA stacks, and how PG Phriday was born. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Fix Circular Role Dependencies Before Upgrading RDS and Aurora Postgres
item.description: Circular role dependencies can stall or roll back a major version upgrade of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL or Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL when you move from PostgreSQL 14 or earlier to 15 or later. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Postgres Calculations and the Ambiguity of NULL
item.description: How Postgres evaluates calculations when a value is unknown: three-valued logic, arithmetic and concatenation with NULL, NOT IN, aggregates and window functions, NULL sort order, and Postgres 19 IGNORE NULLS. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Kafgres: A Kafka-Compatible Broker Embedded Inside Postgres
item.description: Embedding a performant singleton Kafka broker into Postgres. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: chdb: An Extension for Fast Imports from S3, GCS and Azure
item.description: The chdb Postgres extension brings fast imports and exports across cloud storage platforms and data formats, powered by the embedded ClickHouse engine. (1 source: postgresweekly)
